[RTCT.6.7.3] **default + overrides.** When `node_caps_packed`
is empty, a covered node's capacity is the `capacity` of the
matching `node_overrides` entry (keyed by `node_id`), else
`default_node_cap`. `node_overrides` MUST be in strictly
ascending `node_id` order and every `node_id` MUST be a covered
node; a duplicate, out-of-order, or unknown `node_id` is
`DS_ERR_CONTRACT_INVALID`.
